Title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
Problem_Scope: End-to-end differentiable retrieval conditioning for generative QA
Retrieval_Method: Dense Dual-Encoder (DPR, 100-dim BERT) over 21M Wikipedia chunks (100 words)
Verification_Technique: None (Unconstrained generative sequence probability)
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: None (Zero abstention, generates unconditionally)
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: NQ: 44.5 Exact Match (RAG-Seq); TriviaQA: 56.1 EM
Limitations: No citation support, no claim verification, hallucinations on absent knowledge

Title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
Problem_Scope: Replacing BM25 with bi-encoder dense representations for open-domain QA
Retrieval_Method: Dense Bi-Encoder (BERT-base, 768-dim dot product FAISS) Top-k=20,100
Verification_Technique: None (Downstream reader span extraction)
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: None (Reader takes top passage)
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: NQ Top-20 Passage Retrieval: 79.4% (vs BM25 59.1%); Top-100: 86.0%
Limitations: Lacks keyword exact-match precision on statutory codes and numerical thresholds

Title: Measuring Attribution in Natural Language Generation Models
Problem_Scope: Formalizing Attribution Assessment in NLG (Attributable to Identified Sources - AIS)
Dataset_Setup: Attributed QA dataset, 1000 generation samples across 3 domains
Retrieval_Method: External retrieval pipeline (Pre-retrieved passages)
Verification_Technique: Two-stage human & automated NLI annotation: AIS score (binary entailment per sentence)
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Abstention on unanswerable flagged if answer lacks AIS support
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: AIS Agreement with human raters: 84.2% Krippendorff alpha; Baseline PaLM AIS: 71.4%
Limitations: Evaluates post-hoc generation; does not resolve multi-source conflicts or version updates

Title: Attributed Question Answering: Evaluation and Modeling for Attributed LLMs
Problem_Scope: Evaluating whether generated answers are explicitly supported by cited URL/passage pointers
Dataset_Setup: Natural Questions with human attribution annotations (AQA)
Retrieval_Method: Google Search Engine API top-k retrieval
Verification_Technique: Sentence-level citation pointers with Auto-AIS NLI scoring
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Models trained with abstain tokens on low attribution confidence
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: AQA Attribution Precision: 78.5%; Joint Accuracy: 54.2% on NQ
Limitations: Relies on single-source attribution; fails under conflicting multi-document versions

Title: RARR: Researching and Revising What Language Models Say
Problem_Scope: Post-hoc revision of LLM outputs to insert evidence and citations via automated search
Retrieval_Method: Google Search API with iterative query generation
Verification_Technique: Decomposes output into claims, executes searches, applies NLI agreement check
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Omits unsupported claims during revision step
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Attribution improved by +24.1% over raw GPT-3; Preserves 87.3% original text intent
Limitations: High latency: multiple search and LLM calls per sentence (up to 4.2s per claim)

Title: Automatic Citation Generation in Large Language Models: A Survey and Empirical Study
Problem_Scope: Empirical assessment of in-line citation accuracy and citation hallucination across LLMs
Retrieval_Method: Dense + BM25 hybrid search over Wikipedia and Common Crawl
Verification_Technique: Citation Precision, Citation Recall, Citation F1, Subspan verification
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Uncertainty-driven citation filtering
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Citation Precision: GPT-4 (67.2%), Llama-2-70B (49.8%); Hallucinated citations: 32.8%
Limitations: Identifies widespread citation fabrication in un-governed RAG generation

Title: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision
Problem_Scope: Decomposing complex generation into atomic claims for precise factuality auditing
Dataset_Setup: Biographies of public individuals, 500 entity test set
Retrieval_Method: Wikipedia article retrieval as reference evidence
Verification_Technique: Atomic claim extraction via prompt/LM; NLI per claim against reference
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: No direct generation abstention; diagnostic evaluation metric
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: InstructGPT FActScore: 68.3%; ChatGPT: 58.7%; Per-claim precision audit error < 2%
Limitations: High evaluation cost; requires dozens of atomic claim checks per paragraph

Title: TRUE: Re-evaluating Factual Consistency Evaluation across Diverse Tasks
Problem_Scope: Comprehensive benchmark of NLI and factual consistency metrics across 11 datasets
Dataset_Setup: TRUE Benchmark (SummEval, Frank, QAGS, MNLI, PAWS)
Retrieval_Method: Task-specific reference documents
Verification_Technique: Evaluates RoBERTa-NLI, ANLI, T5-NLI, Q2, DAE
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Thresholding NLI entailment logits for consistency decision
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: RoBERTa-large-MNLI achieves ROC-AUC 81.3% across factual consistency tasks
Limitations: Binary classification lacks fine-grained clause-level and normative modality awareness

Title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
Problem_Scope: Adaptive retrieval and self-critique via special reflection tokens
Retrieval_Method: Retriever-agnostic (Contriever-MSMARCO top-k=5)
Verification_Technique: Reflection tokens: [Retrieve], [IsRel], [IsSup], [IsUse] trained via offline critic
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Thresholding [IsSup] token score to trigger alternative generation or abstention
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Self-RAG-7B outperforms Llama-2-13B: PopQA Acc 54.9% (vs 38.2%), Citation Prec 68.1%
Limitations: Requires specialized model fine-tuning; not directly applicable to black-box commercial LLMs

Title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation (CRAG)
Problem_Scope: Retrieval evaluator that triggers web search fallback or knowledge refinement
Retrieval_Method: Dense retriever with lightweight retrieval evaluator
Verification_Technique: Confidence score decomposes into Correct, Incorrect, Ambiguous
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Incorrect triggers web search; Ambiguous combines retrieved and filtered chunks
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Accuracy improved by +12.3% on PopQA; reduces hallucination rate by 34.6%
Limitations: Web search fallback is unacceptable in sovereign/air-gapped private enterprise settings

Title: Investigating the Factual Knowledge Boundary of Large Language Models
Problem_Scope: Detecting LLM knowledge boundaries and self-assessing unanswerable queries
Retrieval_Method: Pre-trained parametric knowledge vs external retrieved context
Verification_Technique: Self-evaluation probability via logit calibration and verbalized confidence
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Abstention when confidence < calibrated threshold
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Calibration reduces false answering on out-of-boundary questions by 42.1%
Limitations: Verbalized confidence is susceptible to sycophancy and overconfidence under leading questions

Title: Semantic Entropy: Probes for LLM Hallucination Detection
Problem_Scope: Quantifying generation uncertainty via semantic equivalence clustering of multiple samples
Retrieval_Method: Standard parametric and retrieved generation
Verification_Technique: Clusters generated candidate answers into semantic clusters; computes entropy over clusters
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: High semantic entropy triggers abstention / refusal to answer
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: AUROC of 0.82 for hallucination detection across diverse LLMs; outperforms raw perplexity
Limitations: Requires generating 5-10 full answer sequences per query, increasing latency and cost 5-10x

Title: ConflictQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Conflicting Information
Problem_Scope: Benchmarking LLM behavior under conflicting parametric vs retrieved, or inter-source conflicts
Dataset_Setup: ConflictQA (10,000 synthetic and semi-synthetic conflicting QA pairs)
Retrieval_Method: Multi-passage retrieval simulating opposing factual sources
Verification_Technique: Source agreement metrics, persuasion bias, recency bias
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Identifies when LLMs arbitrarily favor parametric or first-encountered evidence
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: LLMs exhibit 68.4% bias toward parametric prior when conflicting evidence is retrieved
Limitations: Synthetic entity substitutions do not capture real-world regulatory authority hierarchies

Title: ARES: An Automated Evaluation Framework for RAG Systems
Problem_Scope: Automated, sample-efficient evaluation of Context Relevance, Answer Faithfulness, Answer Relevance
Retrieval_Method: Evaluation of BM25, DPR, and ColBERT retrievers
Verification_Technique: Fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3 LLM judges with Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) error bounds
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: PPI guarantees confidence intervals for accuracy and faithfulness
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Matches human rater rankings with 98.2% correlation using only 100-300 annotated examples
Limitations: Automated judges can inherit systemic biases of their training datasets

Title: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
Problem_Scope: Reference-free evaluation framework computing Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Context Precision, Context Recall
Retrieval_Method: Retriever agnostic (evaluates standard RAG pipelines)
Verification_Technique: LLM-prompted claim extraction and context verification (Faithfulness = |Supported Claims| / |Total Claims|)
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Thresholding faithfulness flags ungrounded generation
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Faithfulness correlation with human judgments: 0.74 (Pearson); Harmonic mean F1 score
Limitations: LLM-as-a-judge prompts show stochasticity and are vulnerable to prompt injection in retrieved text

Title: Evaluating Verifiability in Generative Search Engines
Problem_Scope: Auditing commercial generative search engines (Bing Chat, Perplexity, You.com, Neeva)
Dataset_Setup: 150 search queries across diverse topics with human citation verification
Retrieval_Method: Web search APIs
Verification_Technique: Human and automated sentence-to-URL citation checking
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Abstention not supported by commercial engines; hallucination rate measured
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Only 51.5% of generated sentences are fully supported by their citations; 28.6% contain hallucinated statements
Limitations: Commercial systems prioritize fluency and completeness over citation correctness

Title: Entity-Level Temporal Conflict Resolution in Knowledge Bases and Language Models
Problem_Scope: Resolving temporal contradictions across evolving document revisions
Retrieval_Method: BM25 and dense retrieval with timestamp metadata filtering
Verification_Technique: Temporal anchor comparison and recency precedence arbitration
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Abstains if timeline cannot resolve conflicting facts
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Temporal accuracy improved from 41.2% to 74.8% on evolving knowledge queries
Limitations: Relies heavily on explicit datetime stamps; struggles with implicit regulatory precedence

Title: Passage Re-ranking with BERT
Problem_Scope: Cross-encoder deep transformer re-ranking of top-k candidates retrieved by BM25
Dataset_Setup: MS MARCO Passage Ranking dataset (8.8M passages), TREC-CAR
Retrieval_Method: BM25 first stage (k=1000) followed by monoBERT cross-encoder
Verification_Technique: Cross-attention over (query, passage) token pairs with binary cross-entropy loss
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Score thresholding can eliminate irrelevant passages prior to generation
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: MRR@10: 0.365 (vs BM25 0.187, +95% relative improvement); NDCG@10: 0.428
Limitations: Significant computational latency (100-300ms per 100 passages on GPU/CPU)

Title: Selectively Answering Ambiguous Questions: When Language Models Should Abstain
Problem_Scope: Selective prediction in ambiguous question answering to minimize hallucination risk
Retrieval_Method: Dense retrieval over multi-interpretation passages
Verification_Technique: Disambiguation prediction and selective risk formulation (coverage vs risk)
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Rejects questions with multiple unresolved interpretations unless clarified
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: At 80% coverage, selective accuracy increases by +18.4% over uncalibrated baseline
Limitations: Requires explicit ambiguity detection heuristics; risks high false abstention rate

Title: Don't Hallucinate, Abstain: Calibrating RAG with Dual-Head Abstention Mechanisms
Problem_Scope: Integrating calibrated abstention heads into retrieval-augmented generation models
Retrieval_Method: Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + Contriever)
Verification_Technique: Dual-head architecture: Generation head + Abstention classification head
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Abstains when predicted unanswerability probability > threshold theta
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Reduces hallucinated answers on unanswerable queries from 78.4% to 9.2% with <5% false abstention on answerable queries
Limitations: Requires auxiliary training head; cannot be attached to closed-source API models

Title: Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
Problem_Scope: Security vulnerabilities of RAG systems to indirect prompt injection in retrieved documents
Retrieval_Method: Standard dense and lexical retrieval over tainted document corpora
Verification_Technique: Adversarial prompt injection detection, isolated context delimiters
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Abstains or purges untrusted retrieved chunks when injection detected
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Injection attack success rate reaches 84.6% on naive RAG; context isolation reduces ASR to 6.2%
Limitations: Context isolation slightly degrades retrieval context assimilation for complex queries

Title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
Problem_Scope: Mathematical foundation of selective risk and coverage trade-offs in decision systems
Dataset_Setup: ImageNet, CIFAR-10, SVHN (Applied to NLP selective QA)
Retrieval_Method: N/A (Theoretical decision framework)
Verification_Technique: Confidence selection function g(x) >= theta; Selective Risk R(f, g) = E[loss | g(x)=1]
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Explicit abstention whenever confidence function falls below calibrated risk threshold theta
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: Proves optimal risk-coverage curves under monotone confidence scores
Limitations: Assumes calibrated scoring function; miscalibrated heuristics yield suboptimal coverage

Title: DocuTrust: Multi-Agent Evidence Governance, Policy Version Precedence, and Calibrated Abstention
Problem_Scope: Grounded compliance question answering over heterogeneous regulatory documents with versioning and authority hierarchies
Dataset_Setup: DocuTrust-Bench Frozen Test Set (N=34: 26 Answerable, 8 Unanswerable/Adversarial)
Retrieval_Method: Calibrated Hybrid (BM25 + FAISS Dense all-MiniLM-L6-v2) + Cross-Encoder (ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2, k=8)
Verification_Technique: Sentence-level claim decomposition with normative clause entailment audit
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: Multi-factor calibrated confidence (R, C, A, V, F); Abstains when score < 0.70 or unestablished topic
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: MRR: 0.878; nDCG@8: 0.910; Claim Support Rate: 91.7%; Conflict F1: 85.7%; Appropriate Abstention: 100.0%; False Abstention: 53.8%; Latency: 237.8ms
Limitations: Conservative abstention on answerable queries with partial document coverage; requires human review escalation

Title: DocuTrust Baseline A: Lexical BM25 Only
Problem_Scope: Baseline compliance QA using lexical BM25 retrieval without reranking or governance
Retrieval_Method: Rank-BM25 (k=8) over parsed policy chunks
Verification_Technique: None (Standard generator prompt)
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: None (Always generates an answer)
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: MRR: 0.865; nDCG@8: 0.899; Claim Support: N/A (0 claims verified); Conflict F1: 0.0%; App. Abstain: 0.0%; Latency: 1847.4ms
Limitations: 100% hallucination rate on unanswerable queries; 0% contradiction detection

Title: DocuTrust Baseline B: Dense FAISS Only
Problem_Scope: Baseline compliance QA using dense embedding retrieval without reranking or governance
Retrieval_Method: FAISS IndexFlatIP with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (k=8)
Verification_Technique: None (Standard generator prompt)
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: None (Always generates an answer)
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: MRR: 0.779; nDCG@8: 0.835; Claim Support: N/A; Conflict F1: 0.0%; App. Abstain: 0.0%; Latency: 17.3ms
Limitations: Lower retrieval precision on numerical compliance thresholds; catastrophic hallucination on absent rules

Title: DocuTrust Baseline C: Standard Hybrid (BM25 + Dense RRF)
Problem_Scope: Baseline compliance QA using Reciprocal Rank Fusion of BM25 and FAISS
Retrieval_Method: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) combining BM25 and FAISS
Verification_Technique: None (Standard generator prompt)
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: None (Always generates an answer)
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: MRR: 0.860; nDCG@8: 0.895; Claim Support: N/A; Conflict F1: 0.0%; App. Abstain: 0.0%; Latency: 14.2ms
Limitations: Fails to identify normative conflicts; fails to abstain on out-of-domain queries

Title: DocuTrust Baseline D: Hybrid + Cross-Encoder Reranker
Problem_Scope: Hybrid retrieval with neural cross-encoder reranking but without multi-agent governance
Retrieval_Method: Hybrid RRF (k=60) + ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 cross-encoder (k=8)
Verification_Technique: None (Standard generator prompt)
Uncertainty_Abstention_Technique: None (Always generates an answer)
Key_Reported_Metrics_Results: MRR: 0.878; nDCG@8: 0.910; Claim Support: N/A; Conflict F1: 0.0%; App. Abstain: 0.0%; Latency: 333.4ms
Limitations: High ranking effectiveness but lacks verification, hallucinating on 100% of unanswerable compliance queries
